human_acceptance: Pending; this AI review cannot supply the mandatory human second-person acceptance.
methodology: Four formats (102 each), six protein identities and seventeen flavour labels. All ingredient/amount combinations and actual distinct cooking instructions were read; equal templates were compared across every descendant, including salmon, minced meat and tofu.

review_basis.title: Named dish and protein agree with ingredients and attainable cooking format; flavour labels are interpretations rather than authenticity guarantees.
review_basis.ingredients: Each listed quantity is accounted for, with dry/raw/cooked states matched to method and nutrient evidence; no unlisted oil, cheese, sauce or protein is required.
review_basis.method: Actual instructions assessed for preparation, order, finite heat/time guidance, doneness, cooked-grain use and cold dressing handling across every variant.
review_basis.equipment: Listed equipment supports the actual method, including thermometers where explicitly used.
review_basis.allergens: Known ingredient allergens checked against final tags; bought sauces and substitutions still require product-label checks.
review_basis.nutrition: All five per-serving nutrient fields independently recomputed with decimal arithmetic from the final exact CoFID fixture and ingredient weights. Raw/cooked state corrections checked. Disclosed generic-food and retail-sauce proxies remain estimates.
review_basis.storage: Chilling window, use-by precedence and single-reheat advice checked; rice and already-cooked poultry receive their applicable stricter instructions.
review_basis.food_safety: Raw meat handling, thorough minced-meat/poultry cooking, fish/prawn doneness, canned pulses and cold ingredients checked against FSA guidance.
review_basis.serving_metadata: One-serving portions, dish format and explicit estimated timings checked against method. Appliance/packet timings and doneness govern cooking.

resolved_findings: Added the expressly used spatula, clean plate, oven gloves and scales.
Oven chips now require plain, uncoated chips without batter and weigh the cooked portion, matching baked-chip CoFID values.
Pizza uses a raw base weighed before baking, with its packet pre-bake and final baking instructions.
Turkey mince is restricted to raw 100% turkey breast mince and mapped to raw turkey light meat.
observations: Buffalo/smoky and Cajun/doner labels have equivalent ingredient quantities and methods: 48 two-record pairs. This review supports cookability; it does not claim 408 distinct flavour experiences.
limits: Independent AI editorial review; no human, Matt, clinical or professional-dietitian approval is represented.
Publication remains blocked until the mandatory human second-person acceptance is recorded separately.
Recipes were not physically cooked or taste-tested. Timings and generic-food nutrient values are estimates.
Allergen tags are not a guarantee of suitability for an individual allergy; actual bought-product labels govern.
Approval applies only to the exact listed content hashes and scopes. Any change requires renewed review.
